summary: Backend verification of the new Trip Inspection -> Auto-route Damage Case feature (DECISION-Sprint05 1A=B / 1B=C / 1C=A / 1D=A). 5/5 pytest scenarios PASSED against the live preview using admin@riyadah.tech on TENANT-000001 with real Gemini analyses.
test_scope: Backend only. Trip Inspection autoCase behaviour: threshold gating, persistence of inspection session + AI findings + damage case, report-field mapping (plate->externalVehicleRef, rentalId+others in description), synthetic TRIP-XXXX fallback, and additive response shape.

feature_verification.T1_damaged_with_report_fields: PASS - overall=NEW_DAMAGE_FOUND, costSummary.high >= 1000 QAR, autoCase.created=true with damageCaseId, inspectionSessionId, findings>0, severityCode in {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH}, costHigh==top-level high.
feature_verification.T2_case_listed_and_detail_matches: PASS - new damageCaseId present in GET /damage-cases; GET /damage-cases/{id} returns caseType=REPAIR_RELEVANT, externalVehicleRef==<plate>, description contains 'trip' + Customer + Plate + Rental + Inspector strings; links[] contains FINDING entries (persisted di_ai_findings).
feature_verification.T3_no_damage_no_case: PASS - identical undamaged before/after produced overall != NEW_DAMAGE_FOUND, autoCase.created=false reason in {below_threshold, no_new_findings}; cases list count unchanged (no new id appeared).
feature_verification.T4_no_report_fields_synthetic_ref: PASS - analyze with empty form fields still creates a case (autoCase.created=true) and the case detail shows externalVehicleRef starting with 'TRIP-' (synthetic uuid suffix).
feature_verification.T5_response_shape_intact: PASS - response retains sections, overall, newIssueCount, modelVersion, isAdvisory, branding, costSummary, conditionScore, cleanliness, hasPhotoWarnings, hasIntegrityWarnings, coverage and now also autoCase. Per-section keys (kind, items, newIssueCount, estimatedCost, photoCheck, integrity, comparable) preserved.

critical_code_review_comments: Best-effort auto-routing (try/except returning reason='error') correctly never breaks the advisory analyze response - none of the 4 damaged-image runs hit the error branch; reason='error' was never observed.
_AUTO_CASE_COST_THRESHOLD reads DI_TRIP_AUTO_CASE_COST_THRESHOLD env (default 1000 QAR) - good. Currency comes from DI_TRIP_CURRENCY (default QAR) and is echoed back in the autoCase block.

externalRentalAgreementRef is persisted only on the inspection session (references.externalRentalAgreementRef) - the case itself surfaces only externalVehicleRef. The rentalId is still discoverable via the case description ('Rental: <rentalId>') and via the linked inspectionSessionId; this matches DI's data ownership boundary. No change needed but consider exposing the underlying session refs in case detail if downstream UI needs them.
Description is truncated to 2000 chars (matches CreateCaseIn schema). Construction includes 'trip' marker + descriptor bits + section summaries, satisfying the contract.
dedupeKey is built from session id + sorted finding ids, so each trip creates a unique case (fresh session per trip) - confirmed by the two damaged-image runs producing two distinct damageCaseIds.
Damage case API response correctly excludes Mongo _id (uses str(doc['_id']) as damageCaseId).
seed_data_creation: Two real damage cases were created under TENANT-000001 during the runs (test 1 and tests 4/5 each produce a fresh case). They use TEST_ prefixed customer/inspector names where applicable; vehicle plates use TEST-XXXXXX. They have status=OPEN and can be left as historical advisory cases or cleaned by the main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-case behaviour verified at /api/v1/damage-intelligence/trip-inspection/analyze (multipart). Key fixtures in /tmp/trip/{ext_before.png, ext_after.png} from iteration_13 reliably trigger NEW_DAMAGE_FOUND with high-end cost >> 1000 QAR. Login envelope key is 'success' (not 'ok') and token field is 'accessToken'. List/Detail damage-case responses: list uses {items: [...]} with damageCaseId, detail surfaces externalVehicleRef on the case directly (sourced from session.references.externalVehicleRef) and links[] (linkType=FINDING) for persisted findings. autoCase block shape: {created, damageCaseId, inspectionSessionId, severityCode, caseType, findings, costHigh, currency} on success or {created:false, reason in [below_threshold|no_new_findings|error], thresholdHigh, currency} on skip.
